description: At the end of the day of trade, 95 of 154 lots sold for turnover of 1,154,500 guineas, down 31% year-on-year, and at an average of 12,153 guineas, down 18% from last year. The median came out at 9,500 guineas.

description: Grass veterans Gold Phoenix, Truly Quality, and Mondego head a field of six for the $200,000 Hollywood Turf Cup Stakes (G2T) at a mile and one-half on the day after Thanksgiving at Del Mar.

description: Saffie Joseph Jr. will launch his bid to capture a sixth consecutive Championship Meet training title Nov. 26 Thanksgiving Day, at Gulfstream Park's highly anticipated winter Thoroughbred meet.

description: Juddmonte's unbeaten Consequent will take on eight fillies and mares in the $300,000 Falls City Stakes (G3) on Thanksgiving, Nov. 26, at Churchill Downs. The 3-year-old Into Mischief filly looks to improve to 5-for-5.

title_en: NYRA's Toys for Tots Drive Begins Nov. 27 at Belmont
description: The New York Racing Association announced the return of its annual Toys for Tots holiday toy drive, which will be hosted at Belmont Park for the first time from Nov. 27 through Dec. 15.

title_en: Schweigardt Succeeds Hamilton as Chair of NAICSC
description: Andy Schweigardt has been named chair of the North American International Cataloguing Standards Committee, succeeding Carl Hamilton.

title_en: Leading European Stallion Zarak Dies at 13
description: Zarak, one of Europe's leading stallions, has died at aged 13 following a fatal accident at Haras de Bonneval, the Aga Khan Studs announced Nov. 24.

title_en: Wharfie, Juana Margarita Set for Rematch in Golden Rod
description: After finishing less than a length apart one month ago in the Rags to Riches Stakes, Wharfie and Juana Margarita are set for a rematch Nov. 28 in the $400,000 Golden Rod Stakes (G2) at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Clark At a Glance: Caldera a Threat to Leading Change
description: The Nov. 27 Clark Stakes (G2) at Churchill Downs could showcase one of next season's future stars, given the ripe opportunity created by the retirement of likely Horse of the Year Sovereignty and several other prominent stakes winners.

title_en: Praying to be Offered in F-T December Digital Sale
description: Dual graded stakes winner Praying, a stakes performer at ages 2, 3, and 4, will be offered in the upcoming Fasig-Tipton December Digital Sale, held Dec. 3-9.

title_en: Gregson Foundation Approves $400K in Scholarships
description: More than $400,000 in annual scholarships, a single-season record, was recently approved by the Gregson Foundation board of directors for 34 students for the 2026-27 academic year.

title_en: Coach Pope Aims for Victory in Kentucky Jockey Club
description: Stung by a couple of losses in October, Coach Pope will look to rebound. The colt, that is. The son of Tapit, named after University of Kentucky basketball coach Mark Pope, leads the Nov. 28 Kentucky Jockey Club Stakes (G2) at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Groupie Doll's Last Foal Wins Debut, Named Hot Prospect
description: Jackie's Doll and Bourbon Neat are the latest BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after notching striking victories last week.

title_en: Preakness Stakes Tickets On Sale Dec. 10
description: The Maryland Jockey Club announced Nov. 24 that tickets for the 2027 Preakness Stakes (G1) and George E. Mitchell Black-Eyed Susan Stakes (G2) will go on sale to the public Dec. 10.

title_en: Beyond the Headlines: South Bend at RRP
description: South Bend, or Southie, earned over $700,000 on the track and competed in the 2020 Kentucky Derby (G1). He's now trading the track for a sand arena with jumps alongside Emily Castrenze, owner and founder of Oakmont Thoroughbreds.

title_en: CDI Hopes Casual Fans Connect With 3-Year-Old Series
description: Dollars & Sense with Frank Angst looks at the aims of Churchill Downs Inc. in the new 3-year-old series it will launch with the New York Racing Association next year.

title_en: Keeneland November Sale Produces Market Correction
description: Growth continues at the very top of the Keeneland November Breeding Stock Sale, but averages fell among all other broodmares, broodmare prospects, and weanlings offered. This correction was anticipated following several years of record-setting sales.

title_en: TPD Numbers Show Gramp's Legacy a Horse on the Rise
description: Mills on the Commonwealth Turf Stakes (G3T): Gramp’s Legacy has been on a roll and seemed to take this step into graded company in his stride.

title_en: Doppelganger, Verifying Lead Pleasant Acres' Roster
description: Doppelganger and Verifying will both lead the Pleasant Acres Stallions 2027 roster at $10,000. Verifying first foals will be 2-year-olds next year.

title_en: New Sire Imagination Tops Mountain View 2027 Roster
description: Imagination is a multiple graded stakes winner by leading sire Into Mischief. He sold for $1.05 million as a yearling at the Keeneland September Yearling Sale and went on to earn $2,218,150.

title_en: BH Monday: Gramp's Legacy Rewards Sliney Family
description: On the Nov. 23 episode of BloodHorse Monday: Patrick Sliney discusses Commonwealth Turf Stakes (G3T) winner Gramp's Legacy. Plus, we preview Thanksgiving weekend at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Los Alamitos Winter Thoroughbred Meet Begins Dec. 4
description: Four stakes for juveniles—including a pair of grade 2 events—highlight the 2026 Winter Thoroughbred meet at Los Alamitos. The six-day season will begin Dec. 4 and continue through Dec. 13.

title_en: Renowed Blacksmith Faulkner Dies at 81
description: Native Kentuckian Beach Faulkner had great skills as a blacksmith and horseman. His clients included many elite racehorses and prominent stallions.

title_en: Gulfstream's Championship Meet Begins Nov. 26
description: North America's most celebrated owners, trainers, jockeys, and horses have converged at Gulfstream Park for the 2026-27 Championship Meet that gets underway Thanksgiving Day, Nov. 26, with 71 days of live Thoroughbred action through March 28.

title_en: Erdenali to Skip Hong Kong, Point to 2027 Campaign
description: History-maker Erdenali will not roll on to the Hong Kong Mile (G1) following his impressive win in the Mile Championship (G1) Nov. 22 at Kyoto Racecourse.

title_en: Canterbury Hall of Fame Jockey Bell Dies at 56
description: Canterbury Park Hall of Fame jockey Derek Bell died Nov. 18 at the age of 56. Bell was an accomplished Thoroughbred rider, winning races at multiple tracks with the majority coming at Canterbury.

title_en: Joseph Wins 17th Straight Gulfstream Training Title
description: Saffie Joseph Jr. saddled two winners Nov. 22 to lock up the training title on the final program of the Sunshine Meet, securing his 17th Gulfstream Park meet title in a row.

title_en: Relaxed with Blinkers Off, McCready Upsets Manila
description: With blinkers off for the first time in his eight-race career, a more relaxed McCready was able to run down Let's Be Frank and earn victory in the $200,000 Manila Stakes (G3T) at Belmont Park.

title_en: Hughes Individual Derby Future Wager Favorite in Pool 2
description: Unbeaten Breeders' Cup Juvenile (G1) winner Hughes (6-1) and his sire Into Mischief (4-1) lead the individual morning-line choices for Kentucky Derby Future Wager Pool 2 and the Kentucky Derby Sire Future Wager, which open Nov. 26.

description: Trainer Brad Cox has won the Clark Stakes (G2) just once, scoring with Leofric in 2018, but he has two strong opportunities in Leading Change and Dragoon Guard to add a second victory in the Nov. 27 renewal of the $700,000 race at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Proctor Street Seeks Second Consecutive Cardinal Win
description: Patricia Moseley's Proctor Street returns to Churchill Downs Thanksgiving day to defend her title in the 51st running of the $300,000 Cardinal Stakes, one of two stakes on the holiday card.

title_en: Ka Ying Rising, My Wish Prevail in Hong Kong
description: Ka Ying Rising and My Wish prepped nicely at Sha Tin Racecourse Nov. 22 to take on foreign rivals in the Dec. 13 Hong Kong International Races.

title_en: Erdenali Wins Mile Championship for Aga Khan's Studs
description: Erdenali became the first foreign winner of Japan's Mile Championship with a win Nov. 22 at Kyoto Racecourse, setting up a potential historic double for his owner, The Aga Khan's Studs, with Calandagan seeking a repeat win in next week's Japan Cup.

description: The latest edition of The List updates the battle for stallion supremacy and adds a new entry to the top 25.
